speaker: dad
igboText: Nwa m, ụmụ ụmụ m ga-abịa taa!
englishText: My daughter, my grandchildren are coming today!
statement: Dad says his grandchildren are coming today.
falseStatement: Dad says his children are coming today.

speaker: daughter
igboText: Olee otú obi dị gị, Papa?
statement: The daughter asks Dad how he feels.
falseStatement: The daughter asks Mom how he feels.

speaker: daughter
statement: The daughter says that is good.
falseStatement: The daughter says that is bad.

speaker: dad
statement: Dad says he is also excited.
falseStatement: Dad says he is also tired.

speaker: daughter
statement: The daughter asks what else he feels.
falseStatement: The daughter asks when else he feels that.

speaker: dad
igboText: Enwere m nchegbu. Ha na-eme mkpọtụ!
englishText: I am worried. They make a lot of noise!
statement: Dad says he is worried because they make a lot of noise.
falseStatement: Dad says he is happy because they make a lot of noise.

speaker: daughter
statement: The daughter laughs and asks if he is serious.
falseStatement: The daughter laughs and asks if he is joking.

speaker: dad
igboText: Enwere m egwu. Ha nwere ike iri nri m niile!
englishText: I am afraid. They might eat all my food!
statement: Dad says he is afraid they might eat all his food.
falseStatement: Dad says he is afraid they might break all his toys!

speaker: daughter
statement: The daughter calls out to Dad.

speaker: dad
igboText: Enwere m udo, mwute, iwe, na ike agwụla.
englishText: I am calm, sad, angry, and tired.
statement: Dad says he feels calm, sad, angry, and tired.
falseStatement: Dad says he feels calm, happy, angry, and tired.

speaker: daughter
statement: The daughter asks about surprise too.
falseStatement: The daughter asks about anger too.

speaker: dad
igboText: Ọ dịkwa m iju anya na mmadụ nwere ike inwe mmetụta ndị a niile n'otu oge!
englishText: I'm surprised too that a person can feel all those things at the same time!
statement: Dad says he is surprised that one person can feel all those emotions at once.
falseStatement: Dad says he is surprised that two people can feel all those things at the same time!
